hook: Only *28%* of Hyderabad trips use public transport
hook_b: Only *28%* of Hyderabad trips use public transport
tldr: Transport for London CTO Shashi Verma said Hyderabad must raise public transport's share of daily travel to at least 40%.

beats.what: Verma spoke at Hyderabad Metro Rail Bhavan on lessons from London for the city's traffic.
beats.why: He said road widening and flyovers give limited relief; metro, buses and footpaths are needed.
beats.care: He suggested demand-management steps to discourage excessive private vehicle use.
